name: odoo-mcp
description: Talk to any Odoo 16+ database with zero Odoo-side setup. Local stdio MCP. Hosted free product: ERPipe (mcp.erpipe.com). Requires uv.
long_description: Odoo MCP turns any Odoo 16+ database into a Model Context Protocol server using only your existing credentials — no App Store module, no admin access. 41 tools: bounded reads, server-side aggregation, schema discovery, diagnostics, migration helpers, local BM25 knowledge search, accounting reports, cross-instance fan-out, and a gated write workflow with approval tokens and an audit trail. Speaks XML-RPC for Odoo 16-18 and External JSON-2 for Odoo 19+. Prefer ChatGPT/Claude on a remote URL without running a process? Use free hosted ERPipe at https://mcp.erpipe.com/ (same product family).
